text: Okay, so the other thing is, I have those two watches. Yeah, one of them is the silicone one. I actually want to change that one to a metal strap instead. Does that work? And if there are different colors for the metal one, I'd prefer white, if possible. Can you help me change that?
zh: 好的，所以还有一件事，我有那两块手表。是的，其中一块是硅胶的。实际上，我想将那块手表换成金属表带。可以吗？如果金属表带有不同的颜色，我最好要白色的，如果可能的话。您能帮我更改吗？
